usage: 跑步 can be used as a noun or a verb depending on context.
When used as a noun, it refers to the activity of running.
As a verb, it means 'to run' as an action.
You can use 跑步 + 了 to indicate completed action, e.g., 我跑步了.
It can combine with other verbs to show ongoing actions, e.g., 我想去跑步.
